title: Sam Altman just revealed AGI is 2 years away — here is what that means

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AGI in two years is not just possible—it’s inevitable with the right protocols and aligned incentives in place.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Altman’s timeline ignores the massive computational and ethical hurdles that even top labs haven’t solved yet.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The OpenAI collaboration with Microsoft and access to Azure’s supercomputing resources is a concrete step toward AGI.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Altman’s optimism lacks accountability—no real roadmap for alignment or safety beyond vague, aspirational goals.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AGI in two years is a dangerous illusion without verifiable progress on alignment and scalable, safe training methods.
